backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend types (user profiles, rituals, challenges, love languages, pairing, streaks, badges) and including mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: badge filtering logic, Love Challenges backend persistence, Spin the Love Wheel physics, Activities tab real-time polling, and badge unlock progress feedback.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration with details on styling, functionality, and recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining colors for background, foreground, cards, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with favicon links, viewport settings, and a pre-React script that initializes theme (dark/light) from localStorage to prevent flash on load.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: QA checklist for Version 66 reset verification and historical checklists for versions 76, 64, 63, and 62 covering draft labels, theme toggle, data guards, and feature removals.
frontend/QA_VERSION_66_RESET_REPORT.md: Verification report confirming successful restoration to Version 66 snapshot with passing checks for draft build labels, build stability, core functionality, and absence of post-v66 features.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing authentication state, user profile loading, tab navigation between pages (Home, Insights, Activities, Us, Memories), and conditional rendering of Landing, ProfileSetup, or authenticated app with BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar component with five tabs (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us), each with an icon and label, highlighting the active tab with animations.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Renders a floating heart animation overlay with 12 randomly positioned hearts that animate upward, used for completion celebrations.
frontend/src/components/CoupleLevelXPMod: Displays couple level and XP progress in a card with a progress bar, showing current level, XP toward next level, and level label using insights data.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, and section header states with consistent styling, icons, and optional retry actions.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Card component displaying current harmony percentage, 7-day trend sparkline, trend direction indicator, and breakdown of contributing factors (quiz overlap, completion rate) with expandable explanation.
Compact button-style component showing harmony percentage and trend icon, navigating to Insights page when clicked, designed for Home page quick access.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Brand logo component displaying GrowInLove tree logo image with text, supporting default and compact variants, with text-only fallback on image load error.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Dialog component that displays footer content (About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, Investor) in a modal with scrollable text sections. Uses shadcn/ui Dialog components and pulls contact email from a content file.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a single hero screenshot in a phone mockup frame with notch, gradient background, and responsive sizing. Uses screenshot data from landingScreenshots content file.
Expandable founder story component that shows 3 preview paragraphs with a "Read more/less" toggle button. Splits founderStory content by double newlines into paragraphs.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Auto-rotating carousel that displays app screenshots in a phone mockup with navigation buttons and dot indicators. Cycles through carouselScreenshots every 4 seconds with manual controls.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states. Clears React Query cache on logout and handles authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Displays 15 love language challenges organized by category with completion tracking. Users can mark challenges complete, filter by love language, and see progress stats with confetti animation.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Card component for love languages feature with configurable subtitle, status, and action buttons. Includes optional highlight animation and loading state support.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form that collects user's name to initialize their profile. Shows success animation with checkmark before calling onSuccess callback after 800ms delay.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays reward progress visualizations including streak boosts, heart-shaped progress meters, and milestone badges based on challenge completion data from insights API.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel component that randomly selects a love language for daily activities, with localStorage-based daily spin limiting and smooth animation using requestAnimationFrame.
frontend/src/components/StreakMilestoneB: Displays streak milestone badges (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 100 days) with progress tracking toward the next unlockable badge based on current streak data.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Simple button component that toggles between light and dark themes using the useTheme hook, displaying sun/moon icons.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays love language activity packs that unlock based on streak milestones, with each pack containing themed activities for different love languages.
frontend/src/config/draftBuildLabel.ts: Configuration file that returns the current draft build version label ('Draft Version 66') for preview identification.
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the contact email address constant for the application.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Contains the founder story narrative text explaining how GrowInLove was created during a four-day app competition to strengthen the founders' relationship.
Defines screenshot configurations for landing page hero and carousel sections, including image paths and captions for various app features.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider for theme management supporting light, dark, and system preferences with localStorage persistence and system preference detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: React hook that detects and tracks the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query preference for accessibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, rituals, challenges, quizzes, insights, photos, and admin functions using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: React hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when elements enter the viewport for entrance animations, with automatic disabling for users who prefer reduced motion.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re-exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom romantic-themed color variables using OKLCH color space for both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for gradients and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Activities page displaying love challenges, couple XP, streak badges, rewards, spin wheel, and unlock packs, with pairing requirement (bypassed for admins).
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page displaying daily rituals with prompts, response submission (text/photo/voice), completion animations, and a scrollable history of past ritual entries with love language focus indicators.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Analytics dashboard showing relationship metrics including current/longest streaks, average harmony score, harmony trend breakdown, love language compatibility, milestone badges, and celebration animations for achievements.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Public landing page with hero section, feature highlights, screenshot carousel, privacy information, brand story, and call-to-action buttons for user login and onboarding.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Interactive love languages quiz with multiple-choice questions, score calculation, results display with rankings and percentages, and ability to save/clear quiz results with partner comparison state.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Archive view displaying past ritual entries with expandable cards showing prompts, user responses, photos, and love language focus, formatted with human-readable dates.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Main pairing page component that handles partner pairing via 6-digit codes, displays partner profiles, love languages, quiz results, and admin features. Includes celebration animations, code generation/entry, and navigation to love languages and insights tabs.
frontend/src/utils/coupleLevel.ts: Frontend-only utility that calculates couple level and XP from insights data (streak, challenges, harmony) using progressive XP thresholds. Provides level labels like 'New Journey' to 'Legendary Couple'.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Utility functions for harmony score display and trend analysis, including percent conversion, 7-day series normalization, and trend direction calculation with visual indicators.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens and cleanup functions to remove sensitive data from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (romantic, peach, cream), typography with Nunito/Quicksand fonts, custom animations (accordion, fade-in-up), and container settings.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting architectural notes, known issues (badge filtering, challenge persistence, wheel physics, real-time sync), and feature requests for the Activities tab improvements.
